title: Examining Objects
description: Learn to examine objects with the cat command

story: Awesome, now you can see the objects around you.
💡 NEW POWER: To examine objects, type 'cat' and the object name.
steps.objective: Use 'cat alarm' to examine the alarm
hints: Type 'cat alarm' to investigate the alarm.

story: Ok - it's switched off. Better get dressed... 👕
Type 'ls wardrobe/' to look inside your wardrobe.
hints: Type 'ls wardrobe/' to look for something to wear.
